04✧AI Dungeon MasterSolo adventures, characters and AI storytellingAI-led adventure
The other half of RPGPOV

Explore in 3D. Adventure with AI.

RPGPOV combines two major advances: a first-person, module-accurate world to explore and an AI Dungeon Master connected to your current location. It can bring in the adventure text, portray NPCs, speak as party members, and use your uploaded character sheets—without you having to explain every room you enter.

Adventure alone whenever you want, or play with friends and a conventional DM who uses the AI as a companion. The local AI beta supports conversations, location-aware narration, and character-sheet PDFs; automatic battle-state tracking is still being developed.

AI DM beta: character-sheet PDF upload and conversation are available in the local build. Automated combat resolution is not yet fully implemented.
How AI-assisted adventuring works
  1. Start the local AI DM beta and connect your own OpenAI API key.
  2. Upload a text-based PDF character sheet in the Character Party Manager, then review and save it.
  3. Explore Barovia in first person; the Adventure Journal provides module-based descriptions.
  4. Ask your AI DM questions, role-play decisions, and discuss encounters. Full combat automation is coming later.
Explore the browser beta
YOUR AI DUNGEON MASTER KNOWS THE ADVENTURE

A world that knows where you are—and can talk back.

As you explore, RPGPOV supplies mapped location and module context to the AI. You make the decisions; your AI Dungeon Master helps bring the adventure to life.

📍 Location awareReceives your current mapped location as you move through Barovia.
📜 Knows the moduleReferences the original Ravenloft I6 room descriptions, encounters, characters, and secrets.
📖 Original narrationDisplays the module's player-facing descriptions verbatim where available.
🚪 Inside and outsideUses mapped rooms, buildings, entrances, and exits for location-specific context.
🎭 NPC role-playingPortrays villagers and other characters, with dialogue shaped by their motivations and knowledge.
🗣️ Character banterHave your party discuss plans, react to discoveries, and debate what to do next.
🛡️ Your character sheetsUpload text-based PDF sheets and review the extracted abilities, spells, weapons, and equipment.
💬 Conversations and choicesAsk questions, investigate, negotiate, and try unexpected approaches.
⚔️ Combat companionDiscuss tactics and narrate encounters; fully automated combat and persistent battle tracking are still being developed.
🔒 Adventure secretsPlayer-knowledge safeguards aim to prevent premature spoilers; beta testing is ongoing.
🎲 Module encountersWorks with mapped adventure context and the existing encounter companion.
🧭 Solo adventureExplore at your own pace, with a conventional DM or with AI assistance.

AI Dungeon Master beta: accuracy and module fidelity are being tested. Full automated combat, live character-state updates, and shared multiplayer AI sessions are not yet complete.

07⌖Map Accuracy & DetailsHow the original adventure maps inspired RPGPOVMap fidelity
Built around the original adventure

Maps Matter

The current RPGPOV beta is a map-first interpretation of Ravenloft I6. The wider dungeon-mapping project covers the castle's levels; the free public beta intentionally unlocks only the listed castle maps. Layout and location relationships are kept as faithful as practical, while the three-dimensional scenery uses artistic interpretation.

Get your OpenAI API key

The downloadable RPGPOV AI Dungeon Master uses an API key you create for your own OpenAI account. You only need this for AI play—not for ordinary exploration or multiplayer.

  1. Open the OpenAI API platform. Go to platform.openai.com/api-keys and sign in or create an account.
  2. Choose your API project. If asked, choose an existing project or create one. API keys are managed for that project.
  3. Create a secret key. Select Create new secret key, name it something like RPGPOV AI DM, choose suitable access permissions, and create it.
  4. Copy the key immediately. OpenAI only displays the full secret once. Keep it private; if lost, create a replacement key.
  5. Check API billing. If needed, set up API billing at OpenAI API Billing. API usage is billed separately from ChatGPT subscriptions.
  6. Launch the installed RPGPOV Windows beta. Select AI Key or Set Up AI, paste your key into the desktop application, and follow its confirmation. Then open the AI Dungeon Master.
Keep your key secret. Do not paste it into this website, share it in chats, commit it to GitHub, or post a screenshot of it. RPGPOV asks for the key inside the installed local app.
